run_clip_text_features: run the script to generate CLIP text embeddings for PartImageNet categories and save to a numpy file
build_clip_embeddings_with_prompt: build CLIP text feature embeddings using a custom prompt template like 'a photo of a' for PartImageNet part categories
test_clip_model_loading: test loading a specific CLIP model variant such as RN50 or ViT-B-16 for text encoding
create_clip_embeddings_with_part_format: create CLIP embeddings with part-of-a naming format by enabling the use_part flag for anatomical part descriptions
summarize_partimagenet_categories: summarize the 40 PartImageNet part categories and their CLIP text feature representations
